sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Ten minutes past 11 on the night of Saturday, November 10, 2012, a loud and frightening sound erupted several miles south of the American city of Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 2012年11月10日，星期六，晚上11点10分，美国印第安纳波利斯市以南几英里处突然传出一声巨大而恐怖的巨响。

sentences.en: The powerful force registered on a regional earthquake sensor, and within minutes, 9-1-1 was jammed with over 500 calls from frantic locals reporting that their homes were left
sentences.zh: 这股强大的冲击力被区域地震传感器记录了下来，几分钟内，911报警电话就被当地惊慌失措的居民打爆了，超过500名居民报告称他们的房屋

sentences.en: rattling from the impact.
sentences.zh: 在冲击下剧烈晃动。

sentences.en: The noise had originated in Richmond Hill, one of many suburban subdivisions in the Perry
sentences.zh: 爆炸声源自里士满山，这是佩里镇众多的郊区住宅区之一，

sentences.en: Township, 11 miles south of the city.
sentences.zh: 位于该市以南11英里处。

sentences.en: The relatively new, middle-class neighbourhood was made up of 125 immaculate houses similar
sentences.zh: 这个相对较新的中产阶级社区由125栋设计相似的完美住宅组成，

sentences.en: in design, single or double-storey family homes with brick frontage, grey roofing, vaulted ceilings,
sentences.zh: 包括单层或双层的家庭住宅，配有砖砌外墙、灰色屋顶、拱形天花板，

sentences.en: and manicured lawns that sat side by side along a small network of streets, bordered on one side by the smock golf course.
sentences.zh: 以及修剪整齐的草坪。这些房屋沿着一个小型的街道网络并排而建，一侧与斯莫克高尔夫球场接壤。

sentences.en: Emergency services rushed to Richmond Hill and found the area in complete chaos.
sentences.zh: 紧急救援人员赶到里士满山时，发现该地区一片混乱。

sentences.en: Properties were in varying states of destruction, windows were shattered, walls cracked or collapsed, doors blown off their hinges, and ceilings caved in.
sentences.zh: 房屋处于不同程度的损毁状态：窗户破碎，墙壁开裂或倒塌，门被震飞，天花板塌陷。

sentences.en: Insulation and ash rained down, and rubble littered the streets and yards.
sentences.zh: 隔热材料和灰烬如雨点般落下，瓦砾散落在街道和院子里。

sentences.en: Panicked residents had gathered on street corners, describing being thrown from their beds,
sentences.zh: 惊恐的居民聚集在街角，描述着自己如何被冲击力从床上、

sentences.en: seats, or knocked off their feet by the impact, and slammed against furniture or struck by falling debris.
sentences.zh: 座位上抛出，或被震倒在地，撞向家具，甚至被坠落的碎片击中。

sentences.en: Richmond Hill's proximity to a municipal airport led to speculation that a plane had crashed.
sentences.zh: 由于里士满山靠近市政机场，人们纷纷猜测是否发生了飞机坠毁事故。

sentences.en: Others were convinced a bomb had gone off, or a clandestine methamphetamine lab had exploded.
sentences.zh: 其他人则坚信是炸弹爆炸，或者是某个秘密的冰毒实验室发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: The level of destruction worsened towards the centre of the subdivision, where the apex of the unknown catastrophe was pinpointed to field fairway.
sentences.zh: 破坏程度越往社区中心越严重，那里被确定为这场未知灾难的中心点——菲尔德费尔韦街。

sentences.en: At number 8355, 34-year-old Dion Longworth had been on the ground level of his two-storey home when the
sentences.zh: 在8355号，34岁的迪翁·朗沃斯当时正待在两层住宅的底层，这时

sentences.en: forceful impact went off, blasting a hole through the floor and causing him to fall into the basement.
sentences.zh: 强烈的冲击波袭来，在地板上炸开了一个洞，导致他掉进了地下室。

sentences.en: He suffered a laceration to his head, but was otherwise relatively unscathed.
sentences.zh: 他的头部受了裂伤，但除此之外相对安然无恙。

sentences.en: Yet, a fire was advancing, and debris prevented his escape.
sentences.zh: 然而，火势正在蔓延，瓦砾阻挡了他的逃生之路。

sentences.en: Dion called out from a cavity to the street outside, catching the attention of his fleeing neighbours.
sentences.zh: 迪翁从一个缝隙中向外面的街道呼救，引起了正在逃离的邻居们的注意。

sentences.en: They tried to rescue him by chipping away at the plasterboard, but the materials had compressed and wouldn't budge.
sentences.zh: 他们试图通过敲碎石膏板来营救他，但材料已经压缩在一起，纹丝不动。

sentences.en: Dion asked about the welfare of his wife, Jennifer, who had been upstairs.
sentences.zh: 迪翁询问他妻子的安危，他的妻子詹妮弗当时在楼上。

sentences.en: His neighbour didn't know how to break the news that their house no longer had an upstairs.
sentences.zh: 邻居不知道该如何告诉他，他们的房子已经没有楼上了。

sentences.en: The fire swept through at an alarming speed.
sentences.zh: 大火以惊人的速度席卷而来。

sentences.en: A police officer who had arrived to the scene frantically radioed to dispatch.
sentences.zh: 一名赶到现场的警察惊慌地通过无线电向调度中心报告。

sentences.en: We've got a person trapped in the basement of a house.
sentences.zh: 我们有人被困在房子的地下室里。

sentences.en: They're burning.
sentences.zh: 他们正在被火烧。

sentences.en: He's trapped in the back.
sentences.zh: 他被困在后面。

sentences.en: He's screaming.
sentences.zh: 他在尖叫。

sentences.en: We need to get a hose to the rear as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们需要尽快把水管接到后面去。

sentences.en: Oh God, I can't get any closer.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我没法再靠近了。

sentences.en: Firefighters attacked the side of the Longworth's house with an axe, but the heat made it difficult to stay close.
sentences.zh: 消防员用斧头攻击朗沃斯家房子的侧面，但高温让他们难以靠近。

sentences.en: Dion remained pressed against the cavity, still pleading to know if his wife was okay.
sentences.zh: 迪翁依然紧贴着那个缝隙，不断恳求确认他的妻子是否平安。

sentences.en: When the firefighters stepped back to spray water towards the space, the entire house suddenly collapsed.
sentences.zh: 当消防员退后准备向该空间喷水时，整栋房子突然倒塌了。

sentences.en: The blaze was under control by the following morning of Sunday November 11.
sentences.zh: 大火在次日，即11月11日星期日，得到了控制。

sentences.en: 80 homes had been damaged, 33 beyond repair.
sentences.zh: 80栋房屋受损，其中33栋损毁严重，无法修复。

sentences.en: Dion Longworth had been killed, along with his 36-year-old wife Jennifer, who had died in the initial blast while laying in the couple's bed upstairs.
sentences.zh: 迪翁·朗沃斯不幸遇难，他36岁的妻子詹妮弗也在爆炸发生时因躺在楼上的床上而当场身亡。

sentences.en: Twelve other residents sustained injuries, including broken bones, lacerations, and smoke inhalation.
sentences.zh: 另有十二名居民受伤，包括骨折、裂伤和吸入性烟雾损伤。

sentences.en: As the investigation into the tragedy began, a safety command post was established to coordinate the multiple insurance companies and officials that were present, including
sentences.zh: 随着悲剧调查的开始，一个安全指挥中心成立了，以协调在场的多家保险公司和官员，其中包括

sentences.en: representatives from the Federal Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives and the
sentences.zh: 来自联邦烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局（ATF）的代表，以及

sentences.en: Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部的代表。

sentences.en: The neighbourhood was put on lockdown as arson investigators sifted through the rubble looking for the explosion's point of origin, ruling out possible causes as they went.
sentences.zh: 社区被封锁，纵火调查人员在瓦砾中搜寻爆炸的起火点，并逐一排除可能的起因。

sentences.en: The house alongside the Longworth's, number 8349 Field Fairway, had sustained the worst damage.
sentences.zh: 朗沃斯家旁边的8349号菲尔德费尔韦街住宅受损最严重。

sentences.en: It had been completely levelled, with nothing but a pile of ash and debris remaining.
sentences.zh: 它被完全夷为平地，只剩下一堆灰烬和瓦砾。

sentences.en: Homeowner, 47-year-old intensive care nurse Monserati Shirley lived at the address with her partner, 42-year-old Mark Leonard, and her
sentences.zh: 房主是47岁的重症监护护士蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉，她与伴侣、42岁的马克·伦纳德，以及她

sentences.en: 12-year-old daughter from a previous marriage.
sentences.zh: 与前夫所生的12岁女儿住在这里。

sentences.en: The family were initially unaccounted for, prompting fears they may have been killed.
sentences.zh: 这家人起初下落不明，引发了他们可能已经遇难的担忧。

sentences.en: As it turned out, Monserati and Mark had been 90 miles away at the
sentences.zh: 事实证明，蒙塞拉蒂和马克当时正在90英里外的

sentences.en: Hollywood Casino in Lawrenceburg for a weekend getaway, and Monserati's daughter was staying with a family friend.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯堡好莱坞赌场度周末，而蒙塞拉蒂的女儿则住在一位朋友家中。

sentences.en: The property's gas meter was found amongst the destruction and displayed a reading
sentences.zh: 该房产的燃气表在废墟中被找到，显示的读数

sentences.en: twice the amount recorded by the household's gas provider three weeks prior, a volume equivalent to three tons of TNT.
sentences.zh: 是三周前燃气供应商记录数值的两倍，这一气量相当于三吨TNT炸药。

sentences.en: When speaking with an investigator, Monserati and Mark reported that a week before the
sentences.zh: 在与调查人员交谈时，蒙塞拉蒂和马克称，在爆炸发生前一周，

sentences.en: blast, the distinct rotten egg-like odour of natural gas was permeating throughout their home, which was ice cold as the furnace was releasing cold air.
sentences.zh: 家中弥漫着一股明显的天然气腐烂臭鸡蛋味，而且因为暖气炉释放的是冷风，屋里冰冷刺骨。

sentences.en: They contacted the gas company to see if someone could fix it, but decided not to proceed with the appointment as an additional rate applied to weekend call-outs.
sentences.zh: 他们联系了燃气公司询问是否有人能修理，但由于周末上门服务需要额外收费，他们决定取消预约。

sentences.en: Mark thought the problem lay with the digital thermostat, so he purchased and installed an older manual model, but it didn't fix the problem, so Monserati asked him to switch it
sentences.zh: 马克认为问题出在数字恒温器上，于是他购买并安装了一个旧式的手动型号，但问题并未解决，所以蒙塞拉蒂让他第二天把它

sentences.en: back the next day.
sentences.zh: 换回去。

sentences.en: The source of the gas leak was isolated to a fireplace that was originally situated in the family's living room.
sentences.zh: 燃气泄漏源被锁定在原本位于该家庭客厅的壁炉上。

sentences.en: As per standard building code, the home was fitted with a step-down regulator, a device that reduces the pressure of gas flow to household appliances.
sentences.zh: 根据建筑规范，该住宅安装了一个降压调节器，这是一种将流向家用电器的燃气压力降低的装置。

sentences.en: But a piece of black pipe had been fitted in its place.
sentences.zh: 但取而代之的是一段黑色的管子。

sentences.en: The on and off switch for the fireplace was also missing, with tool marks indicating it had been intentionally removed prior to the explosion.
sentences.zh: 壁炉的开关也不见了，工具痕迹表明它在爆炸前被人为拆除了。

sentences.en: An extensive search of neighbouring properties, rooftops, sewers and cars commenced, but neither the fireplace switch nor the gas regulator were found.
sentences.zh: 警方对邻近的房产、屋顶、下水道和汽车进行了广泛搜查，但既没有找到壁炉开关，也没有找到燃气调节器。

sentences.en: Experts calculated that it would have taken nine hours for the house to fill with the amount of gas required to cause an explosion of that magnitude, concluding the fireplace
sentences.zh: 专家计算出，房子需要九个小时才能积聚起足以引发如此规模爆炸的燃气量，由此推断壁炉

sentences.en: was likely turned on at approximately 2pm the day of the blaSt. A forensic scientist examining aerial
sentences.zh: 很可能是在爆炸当天下午2点左右被打开的。一位法医科学家在检查

sentences.en: photographs of the remnants of the Shirley home concluded from blast patterns that the detonation originated in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 雪莉家残骸的航拍照片后，根据爆炸模式推断爆炸起源于厨房。

sentences.en: Found within the rubble was the household's microwave, a General Electric
sentences.zh: 在瓦砾中发现了一台该家庭使用的微波炉，型号为通用电气

sentences.en: Spacemaker XL model.
sentences.zh: Spacemaker XL 型号。

sentences.en: Its door had been blown off and recovered elsewhere, meaning the appliance had
sentences.zh: 它的门被炸飞并被在别处找到，这意味着该电器

sentences.en: sustained a build-up of pressure from within before exploding, instead of being crushed from falling debris.
sentences.zh: 在爆炸前内部积聚了压力，而不是被坠落的碎片压碎的。

sentences.en: As no one was home at the time, there was no explanation as to why the microwave had been in use.
sentences.zh: 由于当时家里没人，无法解释为什么微波炉会被使用。

sentences.en: Remarkably, investigators found the appliance's instruction manual and learned that it was fitted with a
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，调查人员找到了该电器的说明书，并了解到它配备了一个

sentences.en: timer enabling it to be programmed to begin cooking up to 24 hours in advance.
sentences.zh: 定时器，可以编程设定提前24小时开始烹饪。

sentences.en: A metal cylinder showed evidence of damage indicative of having blown out from inside the microwave.
sentences.zh: 一个金属圆筒显示出受损迹象，表明是从微波炉内部炸开的。

sentences.en: Additionally, concrete samples of the property's foundation revealed gasoline was present in two locations, including the living room where the gas fireplace was located.
sentences.zh: 此外，对该房产地基的混凝土样本检测显示，有两个位置存在汽油，其中包括燃气壁炉所在的客厅。

sentences.en: With all these factors combined, it was clear that the blast had not been an accident.
sentences.zh: 综合所有这些因素，很明显这场爆炸并非意外。

sentences.en: Monserati Shirley had dreamed of living in Richmond Hill since the subdivision was first developed.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉自该社区开发之初就梦想着住在里士满山。

sentences.en: She had moved to the United States from Puerto Rico in her early twenties, seeking better
sentences.zh: 她在二十出头时从波多黎各移居美国，寻求更好的

sentences.en: employment and financial stability, setting her goal on raising a family in a large home in a nice neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 就业机会和经济稳定，目标是在一个好的社区里买一栋大房子，组建家庭。

sentences.en: While completing her nursing degree in Michigan, she fell in love with a pharmaceutical manufacturer named John Shirley and the two were married shortly thereafter.
sentences.zh: 在密歇根州完成护理学位期间，她爱上了一位名叫约翰·雪莉的制药商，两人不久后结婚。

sentences.en: They relocated to Indiana and in
sentences.zh: 他们搬到了印第安纳州，并在

sentences.en: 2001, Monserati gave birth to their first and only child.
sentences.zh: 2001年，蒙塞拉蒂生下了他们唯一的孩子。

sentences.en: Although Richmond Hill was a little out of their price range, the Shirley's managed to get the bank's financial approval to purchase a block of land in the sought-after location.
sentences.zh: 尽管里士满山的房价超出了他们的预算，雪莉夫妇还是设法获得了银行的贷款批准，在这个抢手的地段购买了一块土地。

sentences.en: In 2003, they began building their dream home.
sentences.zh: 2003年，他们开始建造梦想中的家园。

sentences.en: A two-storey, four-bedroom residence spread over 2,784 square feet with an attached two-car garage and rear patio for entertaining.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋两层楼、四居室的住宅，面积达2784平方英尺，带有一个双车位车库和一个用于招待客人的后院露台。

sentences.en: Over the years, John and Monserati's relationship deteriorated and in 2011, they filed for divorce.
sentences.zh: 多年来，约翰和蒙塞拉蒂的关系恶化，2011年，他们申请了离婚。

sentences.en: As part of the settlement, Monserati kept the house, with John agreeing to pay monthly child support and to financially contribute towards school fees.
sentences.zh: 作为和解协议的一部分，蒙塞拉蒂保留了房子，约翰同意每月支付子女抚养费并分担学费。

sentences.en: Following her divorce, Monserati met and began dating
sentences.zh: 离婚后，蒙塞拉蒂结识并开始与

sentences.en: Mark Leonard, a dancer turned successful construction worker with several developments and investments in the works that afforded him a luxury lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 马克·伦纳德约会。马克曾是一名舞者，后来成为了一名成功的建筑工人，手头有几个开发项目和投资，这让他过上了奢华的生活。

sentences.en: Theirs was a whirlwind romance, and a few weeks after meeting Monserati, Mark moved into her Richmond Hill home, where they settled into a comfortable suburban life together.
sentences.zh: 他们是一见钟情，在认识蒙塞拉蒂几周后，马克就搬进了她在里士满山的家中，两人在那里过上了舒适的郊区生活。

sentences.en: In early 2012, five months into their relationship, Mark fell into a coma as a result of a rare autoimmune disease.
sentences.zh: 2012年初，在他们交往五个月后，马克因一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病陷入昏迷。

sentences.en: Monserati stayed with him as he underwent treatment, and in May, he was finally allowed to return home.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂在他接受治疗期间一直陪伴着他，五月份，他终于获准回家。

sentences.en: She spent the next few months nursing him back to health, and it was only recently that he was back on his feet.
sentences.zh: 她花了几个月的时间照顾他恢复健康，直到最近他才重新站起来。

sentences.en: The pair had spent the previous three weekends away together, when on their most recent trip, their house exploded, obliterating all their
sentences.zh: 两人在过去三个周末都外出度假，就在他们最近的一次旅行中，他们的房子发生了爆炸，摧毁了他们所有的

sentences.en: possessions – from Mark's Cadillac STS and Harley-Davidson motorcycle to an original Picasso painting, as well as $20,000 cash the family had saved.
sentences.zh: 财产——从马克的凯迪拉克STS和哈雷摩托车，到一幅毕加索的原作，以及家里攒下的2万美元现金。

sentences.en: Just over a week after the Richmond Hill explosion, a funeral service was held for Dion and Jennifer Longworth at St Barnabas Catholic Church, where they
sentences.zh: 在里士满山爆炸发生一周多后，迪翁和詹妮弗·朗沃斯的葬礼在圣巴拿巴天主教堂举行，他们

sentences.en: had been married 11 years prior.
sentences.zh: 11年前就是在这里结婚的。

sentences.en: In lieu of caskets, a photo of the couple on their wedding day sat at the altar, along with vases of sunflowers, which were Dion's favourite.
sentences.zh: 祭坛上没有放置棺材，而是摆放了一张这对夫妇婚礼当天的照片，以及几瓶向日葵，那是迪翁最喜欢的花。

sentences.en: Over 500 mourners attended, as Dion was remembered for his quirky sense of humour, creativity, and generosity.
sentences.zh: 500多名哀悼者出席了葬礼，人们怀念迪翁古怪的幽默感、创造力和慷慨。

sentences.en: As an audio engineer, he helped develop award-winning electronic products for digital sound and video company Indie audio labs.
sentences.zh: 作为一名音频工程师，他曾帮助数字音视频公司Indie Audio Labs开发过屡获殊荣的电子产品。

sentences.en: Jennifer was a second-grade teacher at a nearby elementary school, and was remembered for her compassion and optimism.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗是附近一所小学的二年级老师，人们怀念她的同情心和乐观精神。

sentences.en: Monsignor Tony Volz, who oversaw the service, said that the couple had used their wedding vows to promise to love one another until death, and that now, quote,
sentences.zh: 主持葬礼的托尼·沃尔兹蒙席说，这对夫妇曾在婚礼誓言中承诺要相爱直到死亡，而现在，引用他的话，

sentences.en: God has helped them live out their vows.
sentences.zh: 上帝帮助他们实现了誓言。

sentences.en: That evening, police announced that the Richmond Hill explosion was officially being treated as a homicide, confident that Dion and Jennifer Longworth had
sentences.zh: 当晚，警方宣布里士满山爆炸案正式作为凶杀案处理，并确信迪翁和詹妮弗·朗沃斯

sentences.en: inadvertently lost their lives as a result of a targeted attack on the Shirley household.
sentences.zh: 是因为针对雪莉一家的蓄意袭击而无辜丧生。

sentences.en: Through their investigations, a possible suspect had emerged after the discovery of an unlikely survivor of the explosion – a Persian cat named Snowball.
sentences.zh: 通过调查，在发现爆炸案中一个不太可能的幸存者——一只名叫“雪球”的波斯猫后，一名嫌疑人浮出水面。

sentences.en: The pet belonged to Monserati Shirley's daughter, and over the past three weekends, including the date of the blast, Monserati had placed the cat in a kennel.
sentences.zh: 这只宠物属于蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉的女儿。在过去的三个周末，包括爆炸当天，蒙塞拉蒂都把猫寄养在宠物店里。

sentences.en: This was uncharacteristic of her, as Monserati wasn't known to board Snowball when away from home.
sentences.zh: 这很不寻常，因为据了解，蒙塞拉蒂平时出门时并不会把“雪球”送去寄养。

sentences.en: Monserati and Mark's alibis were checked, with records from the Hollywood casino confirming the couple checked in the night before the explosion.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂和马克的不在场证明得到了核实，好莱坞赌场的记录证实这对夫妇在爆炸前一天晚上办理了入住。

sentences.en: Their reservation was for one night, and they returned to the front desk in the morning to extend their stay, but no rooms were available.
sentences.zh: 他们的预订只有一晚，第二天早上他们回到前台要求延长住宿，但已经没有空房了。

sentences.en: Instead, the pair remained in the gaming area, with CCTV capturing them playing blackjack before retiring to
sentences.zh: 于是，两人留在博彩区，监控录像拍到他们在玩二十一点，随后退到

sentences.en: the bar where they remained for eleven hours, intermittently checking their phones and watches until receiving news of the explosion.
sentences.zh: 酒吧，在那里待了十一个小时，期间不时查看手机和手表，直到收到爆炸的消息。

sentences.en: Investigators at the crime scene had also noticed something peculiar when examining the remains of the Shirley home.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场的调查人员在检查雪莉家的残骸时也注意到了一些奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: Household furniture doesn't disintegrate during an explosion, but smashes into smaller pieces.
sentences.zh: 家用家具在爆炸中不会分解，而是会碎成小块。

sentences.en: Yet, for a house that size, there weren't many pieces of furniture strewn about.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于那么大的一栋房子来说，散落在周围的家具碎片并不多。

sentences.en: They found several remote controls and television wall mounts, but no evidence of the electronics themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了几个遥控器和电视壁挂支架，但没有发现电子设备本身的痕迹。

sentences.en: In March the year before, Monserati had briefly put the house on the market and the real estate photos were still available online.
sentences.zh: 前一年的三月，蒙塞拉蒂曾短暂地将房子挂牌出售，房地产照片至今仍可在网上找到。

sentences.en: These images showed the house had been well furnished.
sentences.zh: 这些照片显示房子当时装修得很好。

sentences.en: A tip-off and subsequent inquiries led police to
sentences.zh: 一条线索和随后的调查将警方引向了

sentences.en: Mark Leonard's older brother, Bob, who had stored some boxes of clothing, photographs, personal items, and a set of golf clubs in his son's basement.
sentences.zh: 马克·伦纳德的哥哥鲍勃，他曾把一些装有衣服、照片、个人物品和一套高尔夫球杆的箱子存放在儿子的地下室里。

sentences.en: Bob had told his son that the belongings were salvaged from the Shirley home following the explosion.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃告诉儿子，这些物品是爆炸后从雪莉家抢救出来的。

sentences.en: Yet, when speaking with detectives, Bob explained that his brother had approached him two weeks before the explosion with the items, claiming they belonged to
sentences.zh: 然而，在与侦探交谈时，鲍勃解释说，他弟弟在爆炸前两周带着这些物品找到他，声称它们属于

sentences.en: Monserati's ex-husband.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂的前夫。

sentences.en: Bob also reported smelling gas during a visit to the Shirley home, but was uncertain of the source.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃还报告说，在一次拜访雪莉家时闻到了燃气味，但不确定来源。

sentences.en: The couple's friends, relatives, and neighbours were questioned, with one Richmond Hill
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的朋友、亲戚和邻居都受到了询问，其中一位里士满山

sentences.en: resident recalling that on the day of the explosion, the blinds at Monserati's home, which were typically kept open, were pulled down.
sentences.zh: 居民回忆说，在爆炸当天，蒙塞拉蒂家平时总是拉开的百叶窗被拉了下来。

sentences.en: Another neighbour said that same day he saw Mark Leonard's white work van parked outside the house at approximately 2pm.
sentences.zh: 另一位邻居说，同一天他看到马克·伦纳德的白色工作货车大约在下午2点停在房子外面。

sentences.en: Two unknown men hastily exited the house before driving away in the van.
sentences.zh: 两名身份不明的男子匆忙离开房子，然后开着货车驶离。

sentences.en: An acquaintance described Mark as a scam artist who allegedly used online dating sites to meet and seduce older women.
sentences.zh: 一位熟人形容马克是一个骗子，据称他利用在线交友网站结识并诱骗年长的女性。

sentences.en: He would romance them by picking them up in a nice car, dressing sharply,
sentences.zh: 他会开着好车去接她们，穿着考究，

sentences.en: and taking them to fancy restaurants, where he would then pretend to answer an urgent phone call to discuss
sentences.zh: 带她们去高档餐厅，然后假装接听紧急电话讨论

sentences.en: a business matter, making it sound as though he had an important construction job in the works.
sentences.zh: 生意，让对方听起来好像他手头有一个重要的建筑工程。

sentences.en: Once the women believed the con, he would ask to borrow money and would then disappear.
sentences.zh: 一旦这些女性相信了骗局，他就会借钱，然后消失。

sentences.en: Another of his schemes was to take a woman to the casino and after claiming to have left his wallet at
sentences.zh: 他的另一个伎俩是带女性去赌场，在声称把钱包忘在

sentences.en: home, convince them to place sizable bets on his behalf, then keep any winnings.
sentences.zh: 家里后，说服她们代他下大注，然后将赢来的钱据为己有。

sentences.en: According to Mark, Monserati was okay with him dating other women, as long as the relationships weren't sexual.
sentences.zh: 据马克说，蒙塞拉蒂并不介意他与其他女性约会，只要没有发生性关系就行。

sentences.en: A background check on Mark Leonard revealed a criminal history that began when he was 18 years old.
sentences.zh: 对马克·伦纳德的背景调查显示，他的犯罪记录始于18岁。

sentences.en: In addition to criminal charges for cocaine possession and drug dealing, as well as reports of stalking and
sentences.zh: 除了因持有可卡因和贩毒被起诉，以及有跟踪和

sentences.en: intimidation, he was being sued by multiple women accusing him of scamming them out of money.
sentences.zh: 恐吓的报告外，他还被多名女性起诉，指控他诈骗她们的钱财。

sentences.en: He also had a history of insurance fraud related to a car accident.
sentences.zh: 他还有过与车祸相关的保险欺诈前科。

sentences.en: At the time he met Monserati,
sentences.zh: 在结识蒙塞拉蒂时，

sentences.en: Mark was on house arrest, with his movements monitored by a GPS ankle tracker.
sentences.zh: 马克正处于居家监禁状态，他的行踪由GPS脚踝追踪器监控。

sentences.en: A relative informed police that another of Mark's scams was to intentionally set off the airbags in his car, then submit a claim with his insurance agency.
sentences.zh: 一位亲戚告诉警方，马克的另一个骗局是故意引爆车内的安全气囊，然后向保险公司提出索赔。

sentences.en: Upon receiving the settlement, he would keep the money instead of replacing the airbags.
sentences.zh: 在收到赔偿金后，他会把钱留下来，而不是更换安全气囊。

sentences.en: He had also stolen a truck, insured it in his brother's name and then set it on fire, pocketing the payout.
sentences.zh: 他还偷过一辆卡车，用他兄弟的名义投了保，然后将其烧毁，从中骗取赔偿金。

sentences.en: He owed $77,000 in civil lawsuits and racked up over $60,000 in unpaid accounts.
sentences.zh: 他背负着77,000美元的民事诉讼债务，还有超过60,000美元的未付账单。

sentences.en: Three weeks before the explosion, Mark confided in a friend that he had lost $10,000 at the casino.
sentences.zh: 爆炸发生前三周，马克曾向一位朋友吐露，他在赌场输掉了10,000美元。

sentences.en: Monserati's bank records revealed that she had financial trouble of her own.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂的银行记录显示，她自己也有财务困难。

sentences.en: Struggling with their $160,000 mortgage, she and her ex-husband had filed for bankruptcy in 2007,
sentences.zh: 由于难以负担160,000美元的抵押贷款，她和前夫在2007年申请了破产，

sentences.en: with Monserati taking responsibility for their outstanding debts as part of their divorce agreement.
sentences.zh: 作为离婚协议的一部分，蒙塞拉蒂承担了他们未偿还债务的责任。

sentences.en: She had since taken out a second mortgage for $65,000, of which she was three months late making repayments.
sentences.zh: 此后，她又申请了65,000美元的二次抵押贷款，目前还款已经逾期三个月。

sentences.en: She had put the home up for short sale in 2011, which meant that it was listed for less than what
sentences.zh: 她在2011年将房子挂牌进行卖空，这意味着挂牌价格低于

sentences.en: she currently owed on the mortgage and she would have to come up with the outstanding money to close the deal, so she eventually decided not to sell and took it off the market.
sentences.zh: 她目前欠下的抵押贷款金额，她必须补足差额才能完成交易，所以她最终决定不卖了，并将房产撤出市场。

sentences.en: By November 2012, she was $63,000 in credit card debt and still owed $99,000 in bankruptcy repayments, which she had stopped paying.
sentences.zh: 到2012年11月，她背负着63,000美元的信用卡债务，还有99,000美元的破产还款未付，而她已经停止了还款。

sentences.en: A court hearing had been scheduled in July to address this matter, but Monserati failed to show.
sentences.zh: 法院原定于7月举行听证会处理此事，但蒙塞拉蒂没有出席。

sentences.en: Shortly after Mark Leonard moved in with her in late 2011, she doubled her home contents insurance to $300,000.
sentences.zh: 2011年底马克·伦纳德搬来与她同住后不久，她将房屋财产保险额翻倍至300,000美元。

sentences.en: As suspicions arose around Monserati and Mark, the press requested interviews and social media ran rife with rumours about their personal lives.
sentences.zh: 随着对蒙塞拉蒂和马克的怀疑加深，媒体要求采访，社交媒体上充斥着关于他们私生活的传言。

sentences.en: Monserati told a local news station,
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂告诉当地一家新闻台，

sentences.en: I don't wish this on no one.
sentences.zh: 我不希望这种事发生在任何人身上。

sentences.en: I just want to go to sleep and never wake up.
sentences.zh: 我只想睡着了永远别醒来。

sentences.en: I don't eat.
sentences.zh: 我吃不下饭。

sentences.en: I don't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我睡不着觉。

sentences.en: Everyone's been asking questions.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在问问题。

sentences.en: I don't have no financial issues.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何财务问题。

sentences.en: I'm devastated that I lost it all.
sentences.zh: 失去这一切让我悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: My neighbour lost a life.
sentences.zh: 我的邻居失去了一条生命。

sentences.en: That my whole neighbourhood is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 我整个社区都被摧毁了。

sentences.en: They need to wait till all of the investigation is done and I don't want nobody to point a finger to no one.
sentences.zh: 他们需要等所有调查结束，我不希望任何人指责任何人。

sentences.en: The couple hired a lawyer who issued a statement urging the public to leave his clients alone.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇聘请了一位律师，发表声明敦促公众不要打扰他的客户。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 声明写道，

sentences.en: They wish for the causation of this horrific and saddening tragedy to be determined.
sentences.zh: 他们希望查明这起可怕且令人悲伤的悲剧的起因。

sentences.en: Assumptions by everyone have had a field day at their expense.
sentences.zh: 每个人的臆测都在以牺牲他们为代价大做文章。

sentences.en: They continue to cooperate with authorities and will have no further comments.
sentences.zh: 他们将继续配合当局，不再发表任何评论。

sentences.en: Investigators were yet to uncover any concrete physical evidence to prove Monserati-Shirley or Mark Leonard had orchestrated the November 10th explosion.
sentences.zh: 调查人员尚未发现任何确凿的物证来证明蒙塞拉蒂-雪莉或马克·伦纳德策划了11月10日的爆炸案。

sentences.en: GPS trackers were installed on the couple's cars and their phone calls were covertly monitored, but they failed to uncover anything of significance.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的车上安装了GPS追踪器，他们的电话也被秘密监控，但未能发现任何重要线索。

sentences.en: A man named Mark Duckworth spoke to police.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫马克·达克沃斯的人联系了警方。

sentences.en: He was a decade-long friend of Mark Leonard.
sentences.zh: 他是马克·伦纳德十年的朋友。

sentences.en: He recalled a phone conversation wherein Mark mentioned looking at Ferraris online with the intention of buying one.
sentences.zh: 他回忆起一次通话，马克提到在网上看法拉利，打算买一辆。

sentences.en: When asked how he could afford it,
sentences.zh: 当被问及如何负担得起时，

sentences.en: Mark claimed that tsunami winds had blown out their fireplace, causing their house to blow up, and they had received a $300,000 payout.
sentences.zh: 马克声称海啸般的强风吹灭了他们的壁炉，导致房子爆炸，他们获得了300,000美元的赔偿。

sentences.en: This conversation occurred eight days before the explosion.
sentences.zh: 这次谈话发生在爆炸发生前八天。

sentences.en: Duckworth's statement indicated that Mark and Monserati had been plotting a scheme for some time.
sentences.zh: 达克沃斯的陈述表明，马克和蒙塞拉蒂策划这个阴谋已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: The initial belief was that they had conspired with Mark's brother Bob to enact an elaborate insurance
sentences.zh: 最初的看法是，他们与马克的兄弟鲍勃串通，实施了一场精心策划的保险

sentences.en: scam, having him visit the property to release the gas and set the microwave timer while they were establishing their alibi at the Hollywood Casino.
sentences.zh: 诈骗，让他去现场释放天然气并设置微波炉定时器，而他们则在好莱坞赌场制造不在场证明。

sentences.en: Then, on November 30, an employee for gas company
sentences.zh: 然后，在11月30日，一家天然气公司

sentences.en: Citizens Energy Group notified police that he ran into the Leonard brothers at a bar on the evening before the explosion.
sentences.zh: Citizens Energy Group的员工通知警方，他在爆炸前一天晚上在酒吧遇到了伦纳德兄弟。

sentences.en: As he was already acquainted with the pair, the three struck up a conversation.
sentences.zh: 由于他已经认识这两人，三人便聊了起来。

sentences.en: Mark and Bob asked about natural gas, inquiring how much was needed to fill up a house.
sentences.zh: 马克和鲍勃询问了关于天然气的问题，打听填满一栋房子需要多少气。

sentences.en: The employee compared it to blowing up a balloon, telling them that at a certain point, there was nothing left for it to do but explode.
sentences.zh: 该员工将其比作吹气球，告诉他们到了一定程度，除了爆炸别无他法。

sentences.en: On December 21, 2012, almost six weeks after the Richmond Hill explosion, Monserati Shirley and Mark Leonard were arrested and served with a 49-count indictment,
sentences.zh: 2012年12月21日，在里士满山爆炸案发生近六周后，蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉和马克·伦纳德被捕，并收到了49项指控的起诉书，

sentences.en: which included charges for first-degree murder and arson, as well as conspiracy to commit arson and insurance fraud.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一级谋杀罪和纵火罪，以及共谋纵火和保险诈骗罪。

sentences.en: Their suspected accomplice, Bob Leonard was also arrested for murder and arson, but was spared the conspiracy charges.
sentences.zh: 他们涉嫌的同伙鲍勃·伦纳德也因谋杀和纵火罪被捕，但未被控共谋罪。

sentences.en: Given the severity of their crimes, the trio faced the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们罪行的严重性，这三人面临死刑。

sentences.en: Many residents of Richmond Hill were left unsurprised by the arrests, with one remarking, there were too many circumstantial things that fell into line for it not to have been
sentences.zh: 许多里士满山的居民对这次逮捕并不感到惊讶，其中一人评论说，有太多的间接证据吻合，不可能是

sentences.en: them.
sentences.zh: 他们干的。

sentences.en: While another said that it was clear from the very beginning that the explosion had not been an accident.
sentences.zh: 而另一个人说，从一开始就很清楚，爆炸绝非意外。

sentences.en: On December 24, the trio appeared in court where they each entered a plea of not guilty.
sentences.zh: 12月24日，三人出庭，均表示不认罪。

sentences.en: As the arrests occurred just a few days before Christmas, the Richmond Hill community came together to
sentences.zh: 由于逮捕发生在圣诞节前几天，里士满山社区团结起来，

sentences.en: replace some of the possessions to replace some of the possessions Monserati's 12-year-old daughter had
sentences.zh: 帮助蒙塞拉蒂12岁的女儿替换掉她在

sentences.en: lost in the blaSt. During the first few months of Mark Leonard's incarceration, he was placed in a cell with Robert Smitty Smith, a member of an outlaw motorcycle gang and neo-Nazi
sentences.zh: 爆炸中失去的一些财物。在马克·伦纳德入狱的最初几个月里，他与罗伯特·“史密蒂”·史密斯关在同一个牢房，此人是一个非法摩托车帮派和新纳粹

sentences.en: organisation.
sentences.zh: 组织的成员。

sentences.en: As the soulmates got to know one another, Mark discussed the Richmond Hill explosion.
sentences.zh: 随着这两个“灵魂伴侣”互相了解，马克谈到了里士满山爆炸案。

sentences.en: He said the plan had been for his brother to start a fire by cracking a gas line while
sentences.zh: 他说计划本来是他兄弟通过弄裂天然气管道来纵火，而

sentences.en: he and Monserati were away for the weekend, but Bob had broken the line completely, causing the explosion.
sentences.zh: 他和蒙塞拉蒂周末外出，但鲍勃把管道完全弄断了，导致了爆炸。

sentences.en: He believed the strongest piece of evidence the prosecutors had against him was Mark Duckworth's statement that he had been shopping for a Ferrari one week before the incident.
sentences.zh: 他认为检方对他最有利的证据是马克·达克沃斯的陈述，即他在事件发生前一周曾去买法拉利。

sentences.en: He was therefore convinced he stood a chance of beating the charges if he could just stop Duckworth from testifying.
sentences.zh: 因此，他确信如果能阻止达克沃斯作证，他就有机会摆脱指控。

sentences.en: Mark wrote Smitty a note asking if there was any way he could organise a hit on his friend.
sentences.zh: 马克给史密蒂写了一张字条，询问是否有什么办法能安排人干掉他的朋友。

sentences.en: The note said that he didn't want Mark Duckworth to, quote, show up for court, or show up at all, and offered a payment of $15,000 to make him disappear by staging an accident.
sentences.zh: 字条上说，他不希望马克·达克沃斯“出庭”，或者根本不要出现，并提出支付15,000美元，通过制造意外让他消失。

sentences.en: A hand-drawn map to Duckworth's house was included, along with details about the car he drove.
sentences.zh: 字条里附带了一张手绘的达克沃斯家地图，以及他所驾驶车辆的详细信息。

sentences.en: Smitty told Mark that he knew a hitman who would be willing to do the job and the two made plans,
sentences.zh: 史密蒂告诉马克，他认识一个愿意干这活的杀手，两人制定了计划，

sentences.en: with Mark suggesting walking right up to Duckworth's house and shooting him in the kitchen while he was sitting at his computer.
sentences.zh: 马克建议直接走到达克沃斯家，在他坐在电脑前时在厨房里射杀他。

sentences.en: Mark expressed hesitancy about using prison telephones to organise the plot, as his calls were being recorded.
sentences.zh: 马克对使用监狱电话策划阴谋表示犹豫，因为他的通话会被录音。

sentences.en: As Smitty was not subject to the same rules, he gave his personal
sentences.zh: 由于史密蒂不受同样的规则限制，他给了马克自己的个人

sentences.en: PIN number so Mark could make the calls without being recorded.
sentences.zh: PIN码，这样马克就可以在不被录音的情况下打电话。

sentences.en: Mark phoned Smitty's contact, a man identified as Jay.
sentences.zh: 马克给史密蒂的联系人打电话，一个被确认为“杰伊”的人。

sentences.en: When asked how he wanted the hit to go down, Mark said,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他想如何进行暗杀时，马克说，

sentences.en: why would take a chain and fucking pound it through his fucking groin area and hang him from a tree?
sentences.zh: “为什么不拿根铁链，该死地穿过他的腹股沟，然后把他吊在树上？”

sentences.en: He offered Jay a $5,000 bonus if he could force Duckworth to call 911 and retract the information he had previously given to police by saying,
sentences.zh: 他向杰伊提供5,000美元奖金，如果他能强迫达克沃斯拨打911，并说出以下内容来撤回他之前向警方提供的信息：

sentences.en: I did not mean to frame Mark and Montserrati for their own house in Richmond Hill.
sentences.zh: “我不是故意要陷害马克和蒙塞拉蒂，让他们背上里士满山房子的锅。”

sentences.en: He ended up asking
sentences.zh: 他最后要求

sentences.en: Jay to make it look like Duckworth had taken his own life, wanting the job done quickly without causing any unnecessary suffering, as that would take too much time.
sentences.zh: 杰伊把这伪装成达克沃斯自杀，他希望工作能迅速完成，不要造成任何不必要的痛苦，因为那会花太多时间。

sentences.en: Jay told him that he enjoyed torturing his victims, to which Mark laughed and responded, well, if you wanna.
sentences.zh: 杰伊告诉他，他喜欢折磨受害者，马克听后大笑并回应道：“好吧，如果你想的话。”

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to Mark, he was actually conspiring the assassination with an undercover special agent from the Bureau of
sentences.zh: 马克不知道的是，他实际上是在与一名来自美国烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局的卧底特工共谋暗杀。

sentences.en: Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives.
sentences.zh: 烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局。

sentences.en: Furthermore, his cellmate Smitty was actually a police informant.
sentences.zh: 此外，他的狱友史密蒂实际上是一名警方线人。

sentences.en: The phone conversations with Jay were recorded, including Mark stating he wanted another undisclosed target killed once the hit on Duckworth was complete.
sentences.zh: 与杰伊的通话被录了下来，其中包括马克声称在达克沃斯被干掉后，他还想杀掉另一个未公开的目标。

sentences.en: Mark Leonard was additionally charged with conspiracy to commit murder, to which he pled not guilty.
sentences.zh: 马克·伦纳德还被额外指控共谋谋杀，对此他表示不认罪。

sentences.en: In August 2013,
Montserrati Shirley filed documents placing a majority of the blame on the Leonard brothers, saying that Mark had been abusive and manipulative throughout their relationship.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉提交了文件，将大部分责任归咎于伦纳德兄弟，称马克在他们的关系中一直具有虐待和操纵行为。

sentences.en: Two months later, it was decided that the three defendants would all be tried separately outside
sentences.zh: 两个月后，决定将这三名被告分开审判，地点在

sentences.en: Marion County to ensure an impartial jury.
sentences.zh: 马里昂县之外，以确保陪审团公正。

sentences.en: The death penalty was also taken off the table and replaced with life in prison without parole.
sentences.zh: 死刑也被取消，改为终身监禁且不得假释。

sentences.en: To mark the one-year anniversary of the Richmond Hill tragedy, faculty members and students at the elementary school where Jennifer Longworth taught second
sentences.zh: 为了纪念里士满山悲剧发生一周年，詹妮弗·朗沃斯教二年级的学校教职员工和学生

sentences.en: grade wore Indianapolis Colts merchandise in tribute of the Longworth's favourite football team and held a minute's silence.
sentences.zh: 身穿印第安纳波利斯小马队的周边商品，以纪念朗沃斯一家最喜欢的橄榄球队，并默哀了一分钟。
zh_words: 印第安纳波利斯小马队

sentences.en: Richmond Hill residents were undergoing counselling and still had trouble coping with loud noises.
sentences.zh: 里士满山的居民正在接受心理咨询，仍然难以应对巨大的噪音。

sentences.en: One resident reported struggling to get to sleep as she was haunted by images of blood-soaked people running from the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 一位居民报告说，她难以入睡，因为她脑海中总是浮现出浑身是血的人从社区逃离的画面。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用她说，

sentences.en: It was hard to get over.
sentences.zh: “很难走出来。”

sentences.en: It was hard to get those images out of my head.
sentences.zh: “很难把那些画面从脑海中抹去。”

sentences.en: Many expected that at least one of the accused would strike a plea deal, but as the years went by, this seemed less likely.
sentences.zh: 许多人预计至少会有一名被告达成认罪协议，但随着时间的推移，这似乎不太可能。

sentences.en: Then in January 2015, Montserrati's defence lawyers approached the prosecution team with an offer.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2015年1月，蒙塞拉蒂的辩护律师向检方提出了一个提议。

sentences.en: In exchange for dropping the murder charges, their client would agree to plead guilty to the less
sentences.zh: 作为撤销谋杀指控的交换条件，他们的客户同意对较轻的

sentences.en: serious charge of conspiracy to commit arson and in return, reveal the truth about the explosion and testify against her accomplices.
sentences.zh: 共谋纵火罪认罪，并作为回报，揭露爆炸案的真相，并出庭指证她的同伙。

sentences.en: The prosecution was torn.
sentences.zh: 检方陷入了纠结。

sentences.en: Montserrati's cooperation would help clarify the unexplained details of the crime and settle their suspicions whether any other people were involved.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂的配合将有助于澄清犯罪中未解释的细节，并解决他们关于是否有其他人参与的怀疑。

sentences.en: Yet, Montserrati had been a key player in the plot and they wanted to see her justly punished.
sentences.zh: 然而，蒙塞拉蒂是阴谋的关键参与者，他们希望看到她受到公正的惩罚。

sentences.en: Deputy Prosecutor Denise Robinson, quote,
sentences.zh: 副检察官丹妮丝·罗宾逊说，引用：

sentences.en: She was too involved.
sentences.zh: “她参与得太深了。”

sentences.en: She was the one who got her daughter and her cat out of the situation and left her neighbours in the situation.
sentences.zh: “是她把自己的女儿和猫带离了现场，却把邻居留在了那里。”

sentences.en: While we knew that Montserrati surely on her own would never have caused this crime, it could not have happened without her.
sentences.zh: “虽然我们知道蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉凭她自己永远不会犯下这起罪行，但没有她，这一切也不可能发生。”

sentences.en: Eventually, the prosecution agreed to the deal, much to the disapproval of Richmond Hill's community who wanted to see their
sentences.zh: 最终，检方同意了这项协议，这引起了里士满山社区的不满，他们希望看到他们

sentences.en: former neighbour given the maximum sentence of life without parole.
sentences.zh: 曾经的邻居被判处终身监禁且不得假释的最高刑罚。

sentences.zh: 1月20日，蒙塞拉蒂开始开口了。

sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Within weeks of moving into Richmond Hill,
sentences.zh: 搬进里士满山后的几周内，

sentences.en: Mark Leonard suggested Montserrati double her home contents insurance, stating he wanted to buy expensive items and to begin renovations.
sentences.zh: 马克·伦纳德建议蒙塞拉蒂将房屋财产保险翻倍，声称他想购买昂贵的物品并开始装修。

sentences.en: He also convinced her to sell her car so that he could replace it with a luxury BMW, but ended up getting her a dated Ford Taurus instead, which cost him only $700.
sentences.zh: 他还说服她卖掉自己的车，以便换成一辆豪华宝马，但最终只给她弄了一辆老旧的福特金牛座，只花了700美元。

sentences.en: At this point, Mark's true character began to unravel.
sentences.zh: 此时，马克的真实面目开始暴露。

sentences.en: He wasn't the high roller he made himself out to be.
sentences.zh: 他并不是他所表现出的那种挥金如土的人。

sentences.en: After the explosion, he told loss adjudicators he owned a premium condition
sentences.zh: 爆炸发生后，他告诉理赔员他拥有一辆状况极佳的

sentences.en: Cadillac and Harley-Davidson motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 凯迪拉克和哈雷摩托车。

sentences.en: In reality, he had a beat-up Cadillac he had purchased by selling stolen supplies and equipment from his construction sites, and his motorcycle was undriveable.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他有一辆破旧的凯迪拉克，是他通过变卖从建筑工地偷来的物资和设备买的，而他的摩托车根本无法驾驶。

sentences.en: In early 2012, Mark's gambling habits led him to consider committing insurance fraud by setting a small fire in the garage.
sentences.zh: 2012年初，马克的赌博习惯导致他考虑通过在车库纵火来实施保险诈骗。

sentences.en: His friend, Gary Thompson, had done the same and gotten away with it.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友加里·汤普森曾做过同样的事，而且逃脱了惩罚。

sentences.en: He had also helped another man named Glenn Holtz carry out a similar act.
sentences.zh: 他还曾帮助另一个名叫格伦·霍尔茨的人实施过类似的行为。

sentences.en: In July 2012, Mark urged Glenn to convince
sentences.zh: 2012年7月，马克敦促格伦去说服

sentences.en: Monserati how easy it was.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂这有多容易。

sentences.en: Glenn warned the pair to be careful, as he knew someone who had been sentenced to 75 years imprisonment for arson.
sentences.zh: 格伦警告两人要小心，因为他认识一个人因纵火被判了75年监禁。

sentences.en: As Monserati had no criminal history or prior insurance claims,
sentences.zh: 由于蒙塞拉蒂没有犯罪记录或之前的保险索赔记录，

sentences.en: Mark was confident they would get away with it, but promised to take the blame if they were caught.
sentences.zh: 马克确信他们能逃脱惩罚，并承诺如果被抓住，他会承担责任。

sentences.en: Monserati surely, quote,
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉，引用：

sentences.en: Mark revisited the scam towards the end of October 2012.
sentences.zh: 马克在2012年10月底重新提起了这个骗局。

sentences.en: Gary Thompson had agreed to help, but they just needed Monserati's approval.
sentences.zh: 加里·汤普森同意帮忙，但他们只需要蒙塞拉蒂的批准。

sentences.en: Although she wasn't entirely sure what the plan entailed, she gave the green light.
sentences.zh: 虽然她并不完全确定计划的内容，但她还是开了绿灯。

sentences.en: On the weekend of October 27, she boarded Snowball at a kennel, sent her daughter to stay with a friend, loaded her valuable and sentimental items into Mark's van,
sentences.zh: 10月27日的那个周末，她把狗“雪球”寄养在犬舍，把女儿送到朋友家住，把贵重和有纪念意义的物品装进马克的货车，

sentences.en: and the pair checked in to Hollywood Casino.
sentences.zh: 两人入住了好莱坞赌场。

sentences.en: Mark had offered Gary $5,000 to dump six large cans of gasoline inside Monserati's house, but he panicked and couldn't go through with it.
sentences.zh: 马克曾出价5,000美元让加里在蒙塞拉蒂的房子里倾倒六大桶汽油，但他慌了神，没能下手。

sentences.en: He was supposed to call Mark and Monserati when the job was done, but they never heard from him.
sentences.zh: 他本应在工作完成后给马克和蒙塞拉蒂打电话，但他们从未收到他的消息。

sentences.en: The next morning, they drove to Gary's house, and he lied to the pair about having to call the whole thing off after being pulled over by the police on his way to Richmond Hill.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他们开车去加里家，加里对两人撒谎说，他在去里士满山的路上被警察拦下，不得不取消了整个计划。

sentences.en: Convinced Gary was flaking,
sentences.zh: 确信加里在退缩，

sentences.en: Mark enlisted the help of his brother, Bob, offering him $10,000 to start the fire.
sentences.zh: 马克寻求他兄弟鲍勃的帮助，出价10,000美元让他放火。

sentences.en: The second attempt was scheduled for the weekend of November 3.
sentences.zh: 第二次尝试定在11月3日的周末。

sentences.en: In the lead up, Mark and Gary blocked off the chimney and filled the fireplace with cardboard.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，马克和加里封住了烟囱，并在壁炉里塞满了纸板。

sentences.en: They replaced the digital thermostat with a cheaper manual model and had discussions about programming the microwave in advance with a piece of metal inside.
sentences.zh: 他们把数字恒温器换成了更便宜的手动型号，并讨论了预先设置微波炉，里面放一块金属片。

sentences.en: Mark turned on the fireplace's gas valve, and his brother Bob was expected to visit the home later to tinker with the thermostat to cause it to spark and start a fire.
sentences.zh: 马克打开了壁炉的燃气阀，预计他兄弟鲍勃稍后会去房子里摆弄恒温器，使其产生火花并引发火灾。

sentences.en: But the plan failed for a second time.
sentences.zh: 但计划第二次失败了。

sentences.en: The Leonard brothers went to the library and researched the cause of house fires.
sentences.zh: 伦纳德兄弟去了图书馆，研究房屋火灾的原因。

sentences.en: Afterwards, they went for a drink at the bar where they ran into an acquaintance who worked for Citizens Energy Group and asked him about natural gas.
sentences.zh: 之后，他们去酒吧喝了一杯，在那里遇到了一个在Citizens Energy Group工作的熟人，并向他询问了天然气的问题。

sentences.en: Glenn Holtz tried to deter Mark, expressing the possibility he was going to blow up the whole neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 格伦·霍尔茨试图劝阻马克，表示他可能会炸掉整个社区。

sentences.en: Monserati also begged him to call the whole thing off, offering him the $10,000 in her retirement fund.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂也恳求他取消整个计划，并提出把她退休基金里的10,000美元给他。

sentences.en: But Mark was set on the sixth bigger insurance payout.
sentences.zh: 但马克一心只想拿到那笔更大的保险赔偿金。

sentences.en: On November 9 2012, before the couple left for the Hollywood Casino, they gave Bob Leonard $40 for a part needed to carry out the crime.
sentences.zh: 2012年11月9日，在这对情侣出发前往好莱坞赌场之前，他们给了鲍勃·伦纳德40美元，用于购买实施犯罪所需的零件。

sentences.en: Just after 11pm the next day, Monserati received word of the explosion and returned to
sentences.zh: 次日晚上11点刚过，蒙塞拉蒂收到了爆炸的消息，并回到了

sentences.en: Richmond Hill, where her and Mark discovered the magnitude of damage, injuries and deaths it had caused.
sentences.zh: 里士满山，在那里她和马克发现了爆炸造成的破坏、伤亡程度。

sentences.en: Police questioned 44-year-old Gary Thompson, who admitted involvement in the scheme and corroborated Monserati's version of events.
sentences.zh: 警方审讯了44岁的加里·汤普森，他承认参与了该计划，并证实了蒙塞拉蒂对事件的描述。

sentences.en: Although adamant that he was nowhere near
sentences.zh: 尽管他坚称自己当时根本不在

sentences.en: Fieldfare Way the day of the explosion, police were convinced he set the timer on the microwave.
sentences.zh: 爆炸当天的菲尔德法尔路，但警方确信是他设置了微波炉的定时器。

sentences.en: Consequently, on January 29 2015, Gary was arrested and faced over 40 charges, including two counts of murder, arson and conspiracy to commit arson.
sentences.zh: 因此，2015年1月29日，加里被捕并面临40多项指控，包括两项谋杀罪、纵火罪和共谋纵火罪。

sentences.en: Glenn Holtz was also interviewed by the police.
sentences.zh: 格伦·霍尔茨也接受了警方的问询。

sentences.en: He denied having any recollection of the conversation in July 2012 about setting
sentences.zh: 他否认记得2012年7月关于纵火焚烧

sentences.en: Monserati's house on fire.
sentences.zh: 蒙塞拉蒂房子的谈话。

sentences.en: Police checked Glenn's phone records, which showed 10 calls and text messages between himself and Mark Leonard during the first two weeks of November 2012.
sentences.zh: 警方检查了格伦的通话记录，显示在2012年11月的前两周，他与马克·伦纳德之间有10次通话和短信往来。

sentences.en: On April 14 2015, Glenn was arrested for conspiracy to commit arson, becoming the fifth arrest in the
sentences.zh: 2015年4月14日，格伦因共谋纵火罪被捕，成为

sentences.en: Richmond Hill explosion case.
sentences.zh: 里士满山爆炸案中的第五名被捕者。

sentences.en: On Monday June 8 2015, Mark Leonard's trial commenced in the county courthouse in South Bend, Indiana.
sentences.zh: 2015年6月8日星期一，马克·伦纳德的审判在印第安纳州南本德的县法院开始。

sentences.en: His defence team admitted that while he had been part of the arson plot, he never foresaw the power of the explosion and had no intention of damaging other properties or hurting
sentences.zh: 他的辩护团队承认，虽然他参与了纵火阴谋，但他从未预见到爆炸的威力，也无意破坏其他财产或伤害

sentences.en: anyone.
sentences.zh: 任何人。

sentences.en: They labelled it as, quote, a stupid and selfish insurance fraud that went horribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们将其称为“一起愚蠢且自私的保险诈骗，结果却酿成了大祸”。

sentences.en: They called Monserati a master liar who was fully in on the plan from the outset.
sentences.zh: 他们称蒙塞拉蒂是一个撒谎高手，从一开始就完全参与了计划。

sentences.en: The prosecution argued that Mark knew that the entire house would be destroyed as he had advised Monserati to remove her belongings and relocate her daughter and cat.
sentences.zh: 检方辩称，马克知道整栋房子会被摧毁，因为他曾建议蒙塞拉蒂搬走她的财物，并转移她的女儿和猫。

sentences.en: Furthermore, telling his friend Mark Duckworth that he was expecting an insurance payout of $300,000 indicated he expected the house and its possessions to be a complete write-off.
sentences.zh: 此外，他告诉朋友马克·达克沃斯他期待获得30万美元的保险赔付，这表明他预料到房子及其财物将完全报废。

sentences.en: Given that he understood the potential severity of the explosion, the prosecution
sentences.zh: 鉴于他了解爆炸的潜在严重性，检方

sentences.en: urged the jury to find him guilty of murder, as he knew his scheme came with the high probability of death.
sentences.zh: 敦促陪审团裁定他谋杀罪名成立，因为他知道自己的计划极有可能导致死亡。

sentences.en: The five-week trial saw the submission of over 2,000 pieces of evidence and the testimony of hundreds of witnesses, including Monserati Shirley as part of her plea deal.
sentences.zh: 为期五周的审判提交了2000多件证据，并有数百名证人出庭作证，其中包括作为认罪协议一部分的蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉。

sentences.en: She said she went along with her boyfriend's plan because, quote, I was scared.
sentences.zh: 她说她顺从了男友的计划，因为“我当时很害怕”。

sentences.en: I loved him so much, I would do anything to make him happy.
sentences.zh: “我太爱他了，为了让他开心，我什么都愿意做。”

sentences.en: Outside court, Mark's defence attorney told reporters,
sentences.zh: 庭外，马克的辩护律师告诉记者：

sentences.en: She can tell the truth just as easily as she can tell a lie, and it's hard for the jury to know the difference.
sentences.zh: “她撒谎和说真话一样容易，陪审团很难分辨其中的区别。”

sentences.en: During closing remarks, prosecutor Mark Hollingsworth said,
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，检察官马克·霍林斯沃思说：

sentences.en: Every single victim in this case is a victim because of him.
sentences.zh: “本案中的每一位受害者都是因为他而受害。”

sentences.en: Every single co-conspirator in this case would not be charged but for him.
sentences.zh: “本案中的每一位共谋者，如果不是因为他，都不会受到指控。”

sentences.en: It all comes back to Mark Leonard.
sentences.zh: “这一切都归咎于马克·伦纳德。”

sentences.en: On July 14, 2015, after four hours of deliberation, Mark Leonard was found guilty of all 53 counts.
sentences.zh: 2015年7月14日，经过四个小时的审议，马克·伦纳德被裁定53项罪名全部成立。

sentences.en: Outside court,
sentences.zh: 庭外，

sentences.en: Jennifer Longworth's father, Don, told reporters the conviction was the closest thing his family would ever get to justice, saying,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·朗沃斯的父亲唐告诉记者，这次定罪是他家人所能得到的最大程度的正义，他说：

sentences.en: My wife always talks about what she won't have with her daughter.
sentences.zh: “我妻子总是谈论她和女儿之间将永远缺失的东西。”

sentences.en: You know, going shopping and taking care of her kids and all of these things.
sentences.zh: “你知道，一起去购物，照顾她的孩子，诸如此类的事情。”

sentences.en: We won't have any of that.
sentences.zh: “我们再也不会有这些了。”

sentences.en: As far as I'm concerned, the Leonard gang sentenced my family to outdoor prison for the rest of our lives.
sentences.zh: “在我看来，伦纳德团伙判处了我的家人终身监禁，余生都活在痛苦的牢笼里。”

sentences.en: I grieve for my daughter every day, and tomorrow I will go back to the cemetery and knock the grass off the grave like I do every week, and get right back to business.
sentences.zh: “我每天都在为女儿哀悼，明天我会回到墓地，像每周一样清理墓碑上的杂草，然后继续我的生活。”

sentences.en: Dion Longworth's father, John, said the jury had made the right choice, adding,
sentences.zh: 迪翁·朗沃斯的父亲约翰表示，陪审团做出了正确的选择，并补充道：

sentences.en: This doesn't change anything.
sentences.zh: “这改变不了任何事情。”

sentences.en: It means he won't hurt anybody else outside of prison.
sentences.zh: “这只意味着他不会再在监狱外伤害任何人了。”

sentences.en: But Dion and Jennifer are still not with me.
sentences.zh: “但迪翁和詹妮弗依然回不到我身边。”

sentences.en: During Mark Leonard's sentencing hearing a month later,
sentences.zh: 一个月后，在马克·伦纳德的量刑听证会上，

sentences.en: Dion Longworth's mother, Elaine, gave an emotional statement.
sentences.zh: 迪翁·朗沃斯的母亲伊莱恩发表了一份感人至深的陈述。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: I hate that it had to be my boy who lived the next door to Mark and Montserrati.
sentences.zh: “我恨我的儿子竟然住在马克和蒙塞拉蒂隔壁。”

sentences.en: I hate that they were nothing but collateral damage to them.
sentences.zh: “我恨他们对这些人来说仅仅是附带损害。”

sentences.en: I hate like hell that my brilliant son was brought down by such fools.
sentences.zh: “我恨透了我的天才儿子竟然被这种蠢货害死。”

sentences.en: I absolutely and completely hate that my smart, strong, curious, kind, hilarious, and hard-working son died at such an absurdly young age, and in such a horrible way.
sentences.zh: “我绝对、彻底地痛恨我那聪明、坚强、好奇、善良、风趣且勤奋的儿子，竟然在如此荒谬的年轻岁数，以如此可怕的方式死去。”

sentences.en: I hate that the ashes of my son and his wife share the space of a sealed box not much bigger than a gallon of milk.
sentences.zh: “我恨我儿子和他妻子的骨灰竟然共用一个密封盒，那个盒子还没一加仑牛奶大。”

sentences.en: I hate that his tortured last moments come to me in flashbacks.
sentences.zh: “我恨他临死前受折磨的瞬间不断在我脑海中闪回。”

sentences.en: I so very much hate it was not me that died, instead of him.
sentences.zh: “我太恨了，为什么死的人不是我，而是他。”

sentences.en: Upon handing down his sentence, Judge John Marnoka said,
sentences.zh: 在宣判时，约翰·马诺卡法官说：

sentences.en: A person ought to feel safe in their own home.
sentences.zh: “一个人理应在自己的家中感到安全。”

sentences.en: I know there will be natural disasters, and I know there will be burglaries and thefts unfortunately.
sentences.zh: “我知道会有自然灾害，我也知道不幸会有入室盗窃和抢劫。”

sentences.en: But I think people shouldn't have to worry that someone might destroy the entire neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: “但我认为人们不应该担心有人会摧毁整个社区。”

sentences.en: Mark Leonard received two life sentences without parole.
sentences.zh: 马克·伦纳德被判处两项终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: Six months later, on January 21, 2016, Mark's brother Bob Leonard was tried in Fort Wayne, Indiana, with over 150 witnesses called to testify.
sentences.zh: 六个月后，即2016年1月21日，马克的兄弟鲍勃·伦纳德在印第安纳州韦恩堡受审，传唤了150多名证人出庭作证。

sentences.en: When Montserrati took the stand, she explained that upon hearing of Dion and Jennifer Longworth's deaths, she didn't want any of the insurance money.
sentences.zh: 当蒙塞拉蒂出庭作证时，她解释说，在得知迪翁和詹妮弗·朗沃斯的死讯后，她不想要任何保险金。

sentences.en: Bob allegedly responded with indifference, saying, Oh well, they died.
sentences.zh: 据称鲍勃表现得漠不关心，说：“噢，好吧，他们死了。”

sentences.en: The jury found him guilty of all 51 charges.
sentences.zh: 陪审团裁定他51项指控全部成立。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to two life terms without parole.
sentences.zh: 他被判处两项终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: Gary Thompson's trial was scheduled for later that year, but in August he agreed to plead guilty to
sentences.zh: 加里·汤普森的审判原定于当年晚些时候进行，但在8月，他同意就

sentences.en: conspiracy to commit arson in exchange for having all other charges against him dropped.
sentences.zh: 共谋纵火罪认罪，以换取撤销对他所有的其他指控。

sentences.en: He was subsequently sentenced to 30 years in prison, with 10 suspended.
sentences.zh: 随后他被判处30年监禁，其中10年缓刑。

sentences.en: Bob Leonard called a local television station from prison to voice his disdain at the deal, saying, Gary Thompson was in on this whole thing from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·伦纳德从监狱给当地一家电视台打电话，表达了他对这项协议的蔑视，称：“加里·汤普森从头到尾都参与了整件事。”

sentences.en: In late December 2016, Glenn Holtz also entered an agreement with the prosecution,
sentences.zh: 2016年12月下旬，格伦·霍尔茨也与检方达成协议，

sentences.en: pleading guilty to one count of assisting a criminal in exchange for having the conspiracy to commit arson charge dropped.
sentences.zh: 承认一项协助犯罪罪名，以换取撤销共谋纵火罪的指控。

sentences.en: He admitted to knowing about the arson plot beforehand and not doing anything to stop it.
sentences.zh: 他承认事先知道纵火阴谋，但没有采取任何行动阻止它。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to three years in prison, for which he only served 18 months.
sentences.zh: 他被判处三年监禁，实际只服刑了18个月。

sentences.en: Given that Monserrati surely had reached a plea agreement with the prosecution, she was spared a trial.
sentences.zh: 鉴于蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉已与检方达成认罪协议，她免于受审。

sentences.en: Instead, a sentencing hearing was held where her family and defence team requested leniency on the basis that Mark Leonard was
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是举行了量刑听证会，她的家人和辩护团队以马克·伦纳德存在

sentences.en: emotionally abusive, leading to Monserrati's compliance.
sentences.zh: 情感虐待，导致蒙塞拉蒂顺从为由，请求从轻处罚。

sentences.en: Her neighbours disputed this, arguing that she was a greedy person, obsessed with portraying a wealthy image.
sentences.zh: 她的邻居对此提出异议，认为她是一个贪婪的人，沉迷于展示富有形象。

sentences.en: Multiple victim impact statements were read, including one from Dionne Longworth's father, John, who said,
sentences.zh: 会上宣读了多份受害者影响陈述，其中包括迪翁·朗沃斯的父亲约翰的陈述，他说：

sentences.en: It's kind of weird to think that you're going about your life and someone has a target on your back and they don't care.
sentences.zh: “想到你正在过着自己的生活，而有人把你当成了目标，而且他们根本不在乎，这真是太奇怪了。”

sentences.en: That's one thing I've never seen from any of these defendants, much caring.
sentences.zh: “这是我从未在这些被告身上看到过的东西，那就是关心。”

sentences.en: She protected her child and cat, but she showed no concern for anyone else in the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: “她保护了自己的孩子和猫，却对社区里的其他人毫不关心。”

sentences.en: She traded the lives of our children for her own.
sentences.zh: “她用我们孩子的生命换取了自己的利益。”

sentences.en: Upon delivering her sentence, Judge Sheila Carlyle said to Monserrati,
sentences.zh: 在宣判时，希拉·卡莱尔法官对蒙塞拉蒂说：

sentences.en: You were a mum, you were a nurse, you were a neighbour, and you were a friend.
sentences.zh: “你曾是一位母亲，一位护士，一位邻居，也是一位朋友。”

sentences.en: And in each of those categories, you betrayed your truSt. Monserrati surely was sentenced to 50 years in prison.
sentences.zh: “但在每一个身份中，你都背叛了你的信任。”蒙塞拉蒂·雪莉被判处50年监禁。

sentences.en: She will be eligible to apply for parole in December 2032, aged 72 years old.
sentences.zh: 她将于2032年12月获得假释申请资格，届时她将72岁。

sentences.en: One month later,
sentences.zh: 一个月后，

sentences.en: Mark Leonard was tried separately for his attempt to hire a hitman to kill his friend Mark Duckworth to ensure he couldn't testify against him at trial.
sentences.zh: 马克·伦纳德因试图雇佣杀手杀害他的朋友马克·达克沃斯而受到单独审判，以确保他无法在审判中对他作证。

sentences.en: The court found him guilty of conspiracy to commit murder and he received an additional 50 years on top of his life sentences.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定他共谋谋杀罪成立，并在他终身监禁的基础上又增加了50年刑期。

sentences.en: He lodged numerous appeals, but each was rejected.
sentences.zh: 他提出了多次上诉，但均被驳回。

sentences.en: In late January 2018, Mark was transferred to hospital to undergo treatment for his autoimmune disease.
sentences.zh: 2018年1月下旬，马克被转移到医院接受自身免疫性疾病的治疗。

sentences.en: On January 30, the Indiana Department of Corrections released a statement announcing that he had died of natural causes.
sentences.zh: 1月30日，印第安纳州惩教署发表声明，宣布他因自然原因死亡。

sentences.en: Upon learning of his brother's death, Bob Leonard said,
sentences.zh: 在得知兄弟死讯后，鲍勃·伦纳德说：

sentences.en: I've only been in trouble twice in my life, and both times were his fault.
sentences.zh: “我这辈子只惹过两次麻烦，两次都是他的错。”

sentences.en: I couldn't care less that he's dead.
sentences.zh: “他死了我一点都不在乎。”

sentences.en: I don't have a bit of sympathy for that son of a bitch.
sentences.zh: “我对那个混蛋一点同情心都没有。”

sentences.en: In the years following the
sentences.zh: 在

sentences.en: Richmond Hill explosion, residents reported experiencing ongoing trauma.
sentences.zh: 里士满山爆炸案发生的几年里，居民们报告说经历了持续的创伤。

sentences.en: A third of the families moved away from the subdivision, with six marriages ending in divorce.
sentences.zh: 三分之一的家庭搬离了该小区，有六段婚姻以离婚告终。

sentences.en: To honour their memory, a scholarship titled
sentences.zh: 为了纪念他们，一项名为

sentences.en: The Southwest Elementary Jennifer and Dion Longworth Memorial Award was established in 2012, issued to
sentences.zh: “西南小学詹妮弗和迪翁·朗沃斯纪念奖”的奖学金于2012年设立，每年颁发给

sentences.en: one of one of her former second grade students each year upon their eventual graduation from high school.
sentences.zh: 她以前的一名二年级学生，在他们最终高中毕业时发放。

sentences.en: A press release by the school said the scholarship would serve as a legacy for Jennifer's excellence in education and allow her former students to carry on her love of learning.
sentences.zh: 学校发布的新闻稿称，该奖学金将作为詹妮弗在教育领域卓越表现的遗产，并让她的前学生们延续她对学习的热爱。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: Jennifer had a way of reaching students like no other teacher.
sentences.zh: “詹妮弗有一种与其他老师不同的方式来接触学生。”

sentences.en: Students who were tough to reach.
sentences.zh: “那些难以接触的学生。”

sentences.en: She set the expectations on day one of school, and she got results.
sentences.zh: “她在开学第一天就设定了期望，并且取得了成果。”

sentences.en: She loved her kids.
sentences.zh: “她爱她的孩子们。”

sentences.en: As the Longworths were passionate supporters of the Indianapolis Colts football team, the team's owner, Jim Ursay, was the first person to make a donation to the fund.
sentences.zh: 由于朗沃斯夫妇是印第安纳波利斯小马橄榄球队的忠实支持者，球队老板吉姆·厄赛是第一个向该基金捐款的人。

sentences.en: Dion was an enthusiastic gardener with an extensive knowledge of native wildflowers and a particular love of sunflowers.
sentences.zh: 迪翁是一位热情的园艺家，对本土野花有广泛的了解，尤其热爱向日葵。

sentences.en: He took pride in a hybrid pear tree he planted in their yard on Fieldfare Way, which continues to grow to this day.
sentences.zh: 他为自己在菲尔德法尔路的院子里种的一棵杂交梨树感到自豪，这棵树至今仍在生长。
